subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-off Feishu `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` config contract for per-account/per-target outbound pacing once this branch is rebased and real proof is supplied?
rationale: Source inspection supports the Feishu-plugin-local pacing layer, but adding an operator-facing config key and deciding whether mock-only proof is acceptable require maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
options.body: Proceed with this PR or a rebased replacement after redacted live proof shows same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

options.title: Keep Only Reactive Retry
options.body: Reject the new config surface and document that OpenClaw relies on existing Feishu retry/backoff after rate-limit responses.

options.title: Defer To Broad Rate Limiting
options.body: Pause Feishu-specific pacing and make the broader API/provider rate-limiting tracker own cross-surface queueing policy.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Feishu Pacing
recommendation.body: Proceed with this PR or a rebased replacement after redacted live proof shows same-target pacing and distinct-target independence.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community-maintained plugin owner candidate for Feishu-owned channel behavior.
